d: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.

rv.t: 소소하게 힐링되는 턴제 약간 섞인 스토리 게임 플탐이 2시간도 안되지만 약간 대학생활 체험(?)하는 느낌이고 그림체도 귀여워서 재밌게 한 듯
